I decided to double up on reel meals since I’m behind with editing… Loaded Chicken Twice Baked Potato!!! Nuff said. I wish y’all could taste through the screen omg. I tore this meal DOWN ——————————————— RECIPEEEE! If y'all been following me y'all know I do not measure but i'll try my best.  Ingredients:  - Russet Potatoes  - Heavy Cream - Colby Jack Cheese - Seasonings for taste (in step list)  - Sharp Cheddar Cheese  - Unsalted Butter  - Vegetable Oil - Broccoli (optional for filling) - Aluminum Foil - Garlic Paste  - Sour Cream - EVOO - Cubed Chicken (cut up breasts or tenderloin)  [Baked Potato] * 1st you want to prep your potatoes. You're basically making a baked potato. Take your potatoes (russet) and wash them. Then cover with oil (I used vegetable oil) and individually wrap each potato tightly in aluminum foil. Bake in the oven at 400 degrees F for about an hour. * Once potatoes are soft and cooked completely remove the foil and cut down the middle of each potato, hot dog style. Scoop out the inside of the potato and put into an empty mixing bowl. To the mixing bowl you're going to add 1 stick of unsalted melted butter, tbsp of garlic paste, parsley, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp garlic salt, cooked broccoli, 1/2c grated sharp cheddar cheese, pepper, and 2 tbsp sour cream. Mix together and scoop filling back into potatoes. [Sauce]  * Add 1 tbsp butter to pan, 1 tsp garlic paste and parsley and melt down. Add about 1cup of heavy cream and let cook for 5 minutes to thicken. Add pepper, onion powder and lawrys seasoning salt to season. Add colby jack cheese (about 1cup) and mix until sauce is thick and consistency you like. [Chicken]  * I used chicken beasts and cut into cubes. Add EVOO and seasoned with parsley, onion powder, garlic powder and adobo. Cooked in a greased pan until done. * Add thin layer of sauce on potatoes, then chicken, then sauce again and finally top with more cheese and bake on 125 until cheese is melted. #loadedpotato #twicebakedpotato #chickenloadedpotato #cookingtiktok #chefd #fivestarmeals #dinnerideas #dinnerinspo

Garlic Parmesan chicken pasta ✨ Ingredients  Chicken  - 1.5 lbs chicken breast, cut in half - 1 tsp roasted garlic powder  - 1 tsp smoked paprika  - 1 tsp oregano  - 1 tsp Italian seasoning  - 1 tsp garlic and herb seasoning  - Salt to taste - 1 tbsp avocado oil (for cooking) - 1 tbsp unsalted butter (for cooking) Sauce + pasta - 14 oz fettuccine pasta  - 1 1/2 cup heavy cream - 6 tbsp unsalted butter - 1/4 cup pasta water - 7 garlic cloves (minced) - 1 shallot (minced) - 1 1/4 cups Parmesan cheese (grated)  - 1 tbsp freshly chopped parsley  - 1 1/2 tsp oregano  - 1 1/2 tsp roasted garlic powder - 1 tsp red chili flakes - Salt and pepper to taste  Instructions  - In a large bowl coat chicken breast with about 2 tsp of olive oil, seasonings, salt and mix until evenly coated. Cover and set aside for 30 minutes to marinate. - Heat a skillet over medium-high heat. Add avocado oil and 1 tbsp of butter. - Sear chicken for 5 minutes per side until a golden crust forms. Deglaze pan with a little chicken broth, lower the heat, cover, and simmer until internal temperature reaches 155F. - Remove chicken from pan, cover in foil, and place into oven set warm. Pasta  - Bring a large pot of water to a rolling boil. Salt it heavily. - Cook pasta according to package instructions until al dente. - Reserve at least 1/4 cup pasta water, then drain. Sauce - To the same pan (medium heat) add butter. - Sauté shallot for 1–2 minutes until soft. - Add minced garlic and cook until fragrant (about 30 seconds). - Season with oregano, garlic powder, chili flakes, salt, and black pepper. Mix until well combined and fragrant  -  Pour in heavy cream and mix  - Simmer gently for 3–5 minutes until slightly thickened. - Lower heat and stir in Parmesan  cheese and pasta water. Mix until well combined. Taste and adjust for seasonings. - Add cooked fettuccine and parsley, mixing until well coated. - Stir in an additional ¼ cup Parmesan until fully combined. - Finish with chopped parsley. - Add sliced chicken on top of pasta  - Finish with extra Parmesan, cracked pepper, or chili flakes if desired. • • • #recipes #pasta #dinnerideas #chickenrecipe #foodideas

Next in a sauce, pan, combine sugar, water, and vinegar. Bring to a boil, stirring occasionally, until it turns amber in color. Take off the heat. Mini Cinnamon Sugar Donuts! Ingredients * 1 tsp yeast * 3 tbsp sugar * 110 ml milk (⅓ cup + 2 tbsp) * 1 egg * 280 g flour (≈ 2¼ cups) * 1 tsp salt * 38 g softened butter (≈ 2 tbsp + 2 tsp) Cinnamon Sugar Coating * 140 g sugar (≈ ⅔ cup) * 1 tsp ground cinnamon Instructions 1. In a bowl, mix the milk, yeast, and sugar. Add the egg, flour, salt, and softened butter all at once, then mix and coil fold the dough several times. Cover and let rest for 20 minutes. Coil fold again, cover, and let rise for 2 hours or until doubled in size. 2. Place your dough onto a work surface and shape it into a long log. Using a knife, cut it into 24 equal pieces. 3. Roll each piece into a ball and place it onto a small square of parchment paper. Gently flatten each one, cover, and let rise for 30 minutes. Uncover and let rest for another 5 minutes before frying. 4. Make sure the oil is hot before frying. Carefully place the donuts into the hot oil, gently remove the parchment paper, and fry until golden on both sides. 5. Mix the sugar and cinnamon together. While the donuts are still warm, coat both sides in the cinnamon sugar. #donuts #donut #bread #breadtok #homemade

Nashville Hot Chicken Mac & Cheese  Recipe ⬇️ Ridiculously creamy four-cheese mac and cheese with a crispy golden cheese crust, topped with crunchy fried chicken coated in a spicy Nashville hot oil! Mac & Cheese 16 oz cavatappi pasta 4 tbsp butter 4 tbsp flour 12 oz evaporated milk 1 cup heavy cream 1 cup whole milk 12 oz Colby Jack 8 oz sharp cheddar 8 oz mozzarella 4 oz Fontina 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp onion powder 1 tsp smoked paprika ½ tsp cayenne pepper 1 tsp Dijon mustard ½ tsp chicken bouillon Salt & black pepper Reserved pasta water Fried Chicken 2 lb chicken tenderloins 2 cups buttermilk 2 tbsp hot sauce 2 cups flour ½ cup cornstarch 1 tbsp paprika 1 tsp each garlic powder, onion powder & cayenne Salt & black pepper Oil for frying Nashville Hot Oil ½ cup hot frying oil 2 tbsp cayenne pepper 1 tbsp brown sugar 2 tsp smoked paprika 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp chili powder ½ tsp black pepper ½ tsp salt Directions Cook pasta 1–2 minutes shy of al dente. Reserve 1 cup pasta water. Melt butter, whisk in flour and cook 1–2 minutes. Slowly add evaporated milk, cream, milk and seasonings. Simmer until slightly thickened. Reduce heat to low and melt in 16 oz of the shredded cheese. Reserve the other 16 oz for layering. Fold in pasta, adding reserved pasta water as needed to keep it extra creamy. Layer half the mac in a baking dish, add 6 oz reserved cheese, then remaining mac and 10 oz cheese on top. Bake uncovered at 350°F for 20–25 minutes, then broil 1–3 minutes until golden and crispy. Marinate chicken in buttermilk and hot sauce for at least 30 minutes. Mix flour, cornstarch and seasonings, then coat chicken thoroughly. Fry chicken at 350°F for 4–6 minutes until crispy and 165°F internally. Combine Nashville hot oil spices in a heatproof bowl. Carefully pour ½ cup hot frying oil over the spices and stir until combined. Brush or toss the fried chicken in Nashville hot oil, then pile it over the baked mac and cheese. Enjoy! 🔥 #nashvillehotchicken #macandcheese #friedchicken #comfortfood #recipe

30-Minute Garlic Butter Steak Bites & Potatoes 🥩🥔🧄 If you need a quick and easy dinner idea, you have to try these garlic butter steak bites and potatoes! The potatoes are perfectly seasoned and crispy, and the steak is juicy, tender, and tossed in the most delicious garlic butter. And the best part? You can have dinner on the table in about 30 minutes! 🤤 RECIPE BELOW ⬇️  Potatoes: * 4 russet potatoes, diced * 2 tbsp olive oil * 1 tsp each: salt, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika & Italian seasoning * ½ tsp black pepper Steak: * 1½ lbs sirloin tip steak, cubed * 1 tsp olive oil * 1–2 tsp Montreal steak seasoning * 1 tbsp oil for cooking * 2 tbsp butter * 3 cloves garlic, minced * Fresh parsley Instructions 👩🏽‍🍳 1. Wash, peel, and dice your potatoes. Toss with olive oil and seasonings. Salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, and Italian seasoning. Y’all know I don’t measure. I just season until my ancestors tell me to stop! 😂 2. Air fry at 400°F for 20–25 minutes, shaking halfway through, until crispy. You can also bake at 425°F for 25–30 minutes or pan-fry! 3. While those cook, cut your steak into bite-sized pieces and toss with a little olive oil and steak seasoning. I used Montreal, but use your favorite! 4. Get your skillet nice and hot! Add a little oil and sear steak for about 2 minutes per side until browned. Cast iron works best, but any skillet will do! 5. Reduce heat, scoot steak to the edges, and add butter and garlic. Cook for 30–60 seconds until fragrant, then toss everything in that garlic butter. 6. Turn off the heat, add your crispy potatoes, gently mix, and top with fresh parsley! Serve with cheesy rice, mac and cheese, asparagus, or whatever your heart desires! ❤️ Save this for your next easy weeknight dinner! 🔖 #GarlicButterSteakBites #SteakAndPotatoes #30MinuteMeals #EasyDinnerIdeas #WeeknightDinners

Crunch King’s Thanksgiving Mac N Cheese 🧀🦃 Ingredients Pasta 680g cavatappi (2 x 340g packages) Cheese Sauce ½ cup butter 1½ tsp smoked paprika 1½ tsp garlic powder 1½ tsp black pepper 2 chicken bouillon cubes, grated ½ cup all-purpose flour 6 cups milk 1½ cups shredded cheddar 1½ cups shredded mozzarella Layers + Topping 2 cups shredded fontina 1 cup shredded cheddar 1 cup shredded mozzarella Instructions Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook the cavatappi, pulling it a couple of minutes before al dente since it will continue cooking in the oven. Drain and set aside. Shred all your cheese yourself for the smoothest melt. In a large pot over medium heat, melt the butter. Add the smoked paprika, garlic powder, black pepper and grated chicken bouillon cubes. Stir in the flour until combined. Slowly pour in the milk while whisking. Let the sauce thicken, then turn off the heat. Add the cheddar and mozzarella, stirring until smooth. Taste the sauce and adjust the salt if needed. In a deep 9×13-inch baking dish, add half the cooked pasta and mix with half the cheese sauce until coated. Spread the fontina evenly across the middle. In a separate bowl, mix the remaining pasta with the rest of the cheese sauce until nicely coated. Add it over the fontina layer, letting any extra sauce seep down through the pasta. Top with the remaining cheddar and mozzarella. Bake at 375°F (190°C) for 15 minutes, then broil for 2–3 minutes, watching closely, until golden and crispy. Crack through that crispy top and enjoy!

Strawberry Pull-Apart Bread 🍓✨ Dough: 3 cups all-purpose flour (360g) 5 tbsp melted butter (71g) 3 tbsp granulated sugar (38g) 1 tsp salt (6g) 2¼ tsp active dry yeast (7g) 1 large egg (50g) ¾ cup warm milk (180g) 1 tsp vanilla extract Simple Glaze: 1 cup powdered sugar (120g) 1–2 tbsp milk (15–30g) 1 tbsp melted butter (14g) Splash of vanilla extract Strawberry Compote Ingredients:  300g strawberries (about 2 cups, chopped) 75–90g granulated sugar (6–7 tbsp) 1 tbsp lemon juice 10–12g cornstarch (1–1½ tbsp) 30g water (2 tbsp) Instructions: In a bowl, mix warm milk, sugar, and yeast and let sit for 8–10 minutes until foamy, then add the egg, melted butter, and vanilla and mix until combined; add in the flour and salt and knead for about 8–10 minutes until smooth, then cover and let rise for 1 hour or until doubled. Meanwhile, make the strawberry compote by cooking strawberries, sugar, and lemon juice over medium heat until soft and juicy (about 5–7 minutes), lightly mash, then stir in the cornstarch mixed with water and cook until thickened, then let cool completely. Ingredients: •1 Pound Flank Steak, sliced into thin strips •1 Red Bell Pepper, chopped •1 Green Bell Pepper, chopped •1 Medium Yellow Onion, chopped •Pinch of Salt, for vegetables •2 Tablespoons Avocado Oil, or neutral oil of choice, to cook steak & vegetables Steak Marinade: • 2 Tablespoons Low-Sodium Soy Sauce • 4 Cloves Garlic, minced • 1 Tablespoon Avocado Oil, or neutral cooking oil of choice • 2 Teaspoons reduced-sodium Rice Vinegar •1½ Teaspoons Cornstarch •½ Teaspoon Black Pepper •½ Teaspoon Granulated White sugar, or brown sugar •½ Teaspoon Baking Soda Sauce: •½ Cup Low-Sodium Soy Sauce •2 Tablespoons Beef Stock, or unsalted beef stock •2 Tablespoons reduced-sodium Rice Vinegar •1½ Tablespoon Granulated White Sugar, or brown sugar •2 Teaspoons Cornstarch •¼ Teaspoon Black Pepper •(optional) 2 Tablespoons of water, to dilute if too salty for your taste Instructions: 1. videos.caption: 🥩🍲 Slow Cooker Garlic Butter Beef & Onion Gravy This tender, juicy slow-cooked beef is the ultimate comfort food! Thick, beautifully browned pieces of beef simmer low and slow in a rich, savory garlic butter gravy with sweet caramelized onions. Every piece is coated in a delicious, glossy sauce that makes this dish absolutely irresistible. The slow cooking process allows the beef to soak up all those incredible flavors until it's fork-tender and incredibly juicy. It's the kind of hearty, homemade dinner that fills the kitchen with an amazing aroma and brings everyone to the table. ❤️ 🥘 Ingredients 2 lbs beef chuck steak or boneless beef roast, sliced into thick pieces 2 large onions, sliced 4 cloves garlic, minced 3 tbsp butter 2 cups beef broth 2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce 1 tbsp soy sauce 1 tbsp tomato paste 1 tsp paprika 1 tsp garlic powder ½ tsp black pepper Salt to taste 1 tbsp cornstarch mixed with 2 tbsp water (optional) 👩‍🍳 Instructions Season the beef with salt, black pepper, paprika, and garlic powder. Heat a skillet with a little oil and sear the beef on both sides until nicely browned. Place sliced onions and minced garlic in the slow cooker. Arrange the browned beef over the onions. Mix beef broth, Worcestershire sauce, soy sauce, and tomato paste. Pour over the beef. Add butter on top, cover, and cook on LOW for 7–8 hours or HIGH for 4–5 hours, until fork-tender. If desired, thicken the gravy with the cornstarch mixture during the final 20–30 minutes. Spoon that rich, flavorful onion gravy over the beef and serve hot! 😍 Perfect with creamy mashed potatoes, buttery rice, or warm dinner rolls to soak up every drop of that delicious gravy! Ingredients: 1 1/2 tablespoons olive oil 1 pound boneless skinless chicken breast, cut in ¾” inch pieces 1/2 cup finely chopped onion 1 teaspoon garlic powder 1 teaspoon kosher salt 1/2 teaspoon pepper 3/4 teaspoon chili powder 1/2 teaspoon cumin 1 cup green enchilada sauce or tomatillo salsa, divided 1 can pinto beans, drained 2 tablespoons melted butter 8 6-inch flour tortillas 2 1/2 cups shredded monterey jack cheese 1/2 cup sour cream Shredded lettuce and any other desired toppings Directions: Preheat oven to 375. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Season chicken pieces well with garlic powder, salt, pepper, chili powder and cumin. Add chicken to hot skillet and cook, undisturbed until browned and easily releases from the pan, 3-4 minutes. Add onion and stir chicken and cook, stirring occasionally, 3 more minutes. Add 2/3 cup salsa and beans and bring to a simmer. Reduce heat slightly and cook, stirring occasionally until slightly thickened and creamy, about 5 minutes. Brush sides and bottom of an 11 x 7 baking pan or baking dish with butter. Working with 1 tortilla at a time, use remaining butter to brush one side of each tortilla and place in dish. Place about 1 tablespoons of cheese in bottom of the tortilla and top with about 1/3 cup filling and a couple more tablespoons of cheese. Fold tortilla up like a taco and place it against the edge of the pan. Place a second buttered tortilla against the next one and top with cheese and filling. Fold in half and repeat with remaining tortillas, filling and cheese to fill the baking dish with side by side tacos. Top with any remaining cheese. Bake 20-25 minutes or until tops of each tortilla are golden brown and toasted and cheese is melted and bubbly. Meanwhile, stir together remaining salsa with sour cream until well combined. Hope y’all enjoy this one 🙌🏿🔥  Ingredients:  Green Beans- ~ 44oz Petite Golden Potatoes - 24oz bag Onion- 1 Red Bell Pepper- 1 Garlic- 4 cloves Bacon- 12oz Beef Smoked Sausage- 12oz Flour- 3 tbsp Chicken Stock (low sodium)- 7 cups Chicken Bouillon- 1 tbsp Salt- 1 tbsp White Pepper- 1 tbsp Onion Powder- 1 tbsp Garlic Powder- 1 tbsp Paprika-  2 tbsp Complete Seasoning or All Purpose Seasoning (salt free)- 2 tbsp Worcestershire Sauce- 1 tbsp Hot Sauce- 2 tbsp Cornstarch (for slurry)- 1 tbsp Water (for slurry) - 1 tbsp   Method:  Prep your ingredients before you start cooking to make the process smoother includes: chopping onions, garlic and peppers, chopping up the bacon and sausage, snipping and washing green beans, and cutting the golden potatoes in half.    Cook the bacon in a big pot on medium heat while constantly stirring allowing it to cook in its own fat. LINK IS IN MY BIO 👨🏻‍🍳📚 Ingredients: * 700g Diced Chicken Breast (raw weight) * 1 Tsp Each: Salt, Onion Powder, Smoked Paprika & Garlic Powder * 1 Tsp Olive Oil * 25g Honey * 85g Reduced Sugar or Sugar Free BBQ Sauce (Hughes Sugar Free BBQ Sauce or your preferred BBQ sauce) * 320g Macaroni Pasta (uncooked weight) * 340ml Fat Free Evaporated Milk (Carnation Light & Creamy 99% Fat Free) * 80g Light Cream Cheese * 1.5 Tsp Chicken Stock Powder * 100g Grated Light Cheddar Cheese (Dairyworks Natural Cheddar) Instructions: 1. Add the diced chicken breast to a bowl and season with salt, onion powder, smoked paprika & garlic powder. Drizzle over the olive oil and mix thoroughly until every piece is evenly coated in the seasonings. 2. Heat a pan over medium heat and add the seasoned chicken. Cook for approximately 4 minutes on each side or until golden on the outside and fully cooked through. 3. Reduce the heat to low, then add the honey and BBQ sauce directly to the pan. Toss the chicken through the sauce until every piece is coated in a thick & sticky honey BBQ glaze. Remove from the heat and set aside. 4. Meanwhile bring a pot of salted water to a boil and cook the macaroni according to the packet instructions until al dente. Drain the pasta and set aside. 5. For the cheese sauce add the evaporated milk, light cream cheese and chicken stock powder to a separate pan over medium low heat. Stir until the cream cheese has softened and combined with the milk then gradually add the grated cheddar. Continue stirring until melted into a smooth, rich & creamy cheese sauce. 6. Add the drained macaroni directly into the cheese sauce and mix everything together until the pasta is completely coated in that creamy, cheesy goodness. 7. Divide the honey BBQ chicken and mac & cheese evenly between 4 meal prep containers. Finish with some freshly chopped parsley if desired and enjoy! Meal Prep Pro Tip: Mac & Cheese naturally thickens as it cools because the pasta continues absorbing moisture from the sauce. When reheating add a small splash of milk and give everything a good stir to bring back that smooth, creamy consistency! These cheesy herb popovers wait for no one, and that’s exactly why they're the last thing I make before commencing the Thanksgiving dinner! Fresh herbs, Gruyère, and smoked gouda bake right inside, so they turn out golden and crisp on the outside and soft and almost custardy in the center. You can make the batter a few hours ahead, then bake and serve them hot! INGREDIENTS - 4 large eggs - 1 1/2 cups whole milk, room temperature - 2 teaspoons granulated sugar - 1 teaspoon kosher salt - 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour - 2 tablespoons chopped fresh parsley - 1 tablespoon chopped fresh thyme - 3 tablespoons unsalted butter, melted - 1/2 cup shredded Gruyère cheese - 1/4 cup shredded smoked Gouda cheese INSTRUCTIONS 1. Preheat oven to 450°F and set the rack to the lower position. Grease a 6-cup nonstick popover pan and set aside. 2. Whisk eggs, milk, salt, and sugar until the eggs and milk are smooth. Add the flour, parsley, and thyme. Whisk until mostly smooth. A few small lumps are fine. Pour in the melted and slightly cooled butter and mix to incorporate. 3. Divide batter into the prepared popover pan. Alternatively, a 12-cup muffin pan can be used, but the popovers will be smaller. Combine the Gruyère cheese and smoked Gouda cheese. Sprinkle 2 tablespoons of cheese on top of each popover. 4. Place in the preheated 450°F oven. Bake for 15 minutes, then reduce the heat to 375°F without opening the oven door, and continue to bake for 20-25 additional minutes or until the popovers are fully browned and crisp on top. 5. Remove from the oven and immediately remove the popovers from the pan and place on a rack to cool for 3-5 minutes. Letting popovers cool in the pans will cause them to deflate. Serve hot.

🍯🧄 Sticky Honey Garlic Chicken & Rice Bake 🍗 Tender chicken thighs glazed in sticky honey garlic sauce, baked right over fluffy rice until everything is caramelized, saucy and so easy — a true one-dish dinner! INGREDIENTS: - 1 1/2 lbs (680 g) boneless chicken thighs, cut into bite-size pieces - 1/4 cup soy sauce - 3 tbsp honey - 4 cloves garlic, minced - 1 tbsp fresh ginger, grated - 1 1/2 cups uncooked long-grain rice - 2 cups chicken broth - Freshly chopped green onions, to garnish INSTRUCTIONS: 1.
